module: Single kerb and footway section that all the editor tools build to, and the stone they are cut from. The dimensions live here so that a car feels the same step on a street, a car park, a bridge or a plaza. Also gives the texture rows of a kerb variant.
notes: Spec: slabW 1.65 m (one slab wide), slabThick 0.12, kerbW 0.15, kerbH 0.12 (12 cm above the road), buryM 0.30 (depth from which an edge is said to be buried), materials slabs_large and m_sidewalk_curb_trim_01.
The kerb texture sheet stacks 5 variants in V (a fifth each); the sharp edge must stay on the central row because the normal map carries a rounding there.

spec.desc: Dimensions and materials: slabW, slabThick, kerbW, kerbH, buryM, slabMaterial, kerbMaterial.

kerbRows.desc: Returns the three V rows of the texture occupied by a kerb variant: the back of the step, the edge and the foot of the face. The variant is truncated to an integer and clamped to 0..4; a non-numeric value gives 0.

returns.desc: Row of the back of the step (variant * 0.2).
Row of the foot of the face (+0.2 minus a small gap of 0.00332).
